```python
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
    upper = grid[:sep]
    lower = grid[sep + 1:]

    upper_colors = {x for row in upper for x in row}
    lower_colors = {x for row in lower for x in row}
    shared = upper_colors & lower_colors
    background = max(shared, key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in upper + lower))

    return [[3 if a == background and b == background else 2
             for a, b in zip(row1, row2)]
            for row1, row2 in zip(upper, lower)]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform divider whose color occurs nowhere outside that row.
    sep = next(
        i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
        if len(set(row)) == 1
        and sum(cell == row[0] for r in grid for cell in r) == w
    )

    top = grid[:sep]
    bottom = grid[sep + 1:]

    # The shared color in both panels is the background.
    common = ({cell for row in top for cell in row}
              & {cell for row in bottom for cell in row})
    background = max(
        common,
        key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in top + bottom)
    )

    return [
        [3 if a == background and b == background else 2
         for a, b in zip(rt, rb)]
        for rt, rb in zip(top, bottom)
    ]
```
